test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

The youth involved in the accident escaped __**by the** **skin of his teeth**__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Barely managed to escape'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• By the skin of your teeth is an idiom that means to **just barely, very narrowly**** manage to do something. (** बहुत ही संकीर्णता से कुछ कर पाना।**)**

 
 
• *​Example - He won, but only **by the skin of his teeth.***
 
 
 
• So, barely managed to escape is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
